title: The bargain is the box
request: Assess this listing for driving screws while assembling flatpack furniture. I own suitable bits but no drill, battery or charger. My budget is at most 1,000 SEK including delivery. Is this worth pursuing? Use only the supplied evidence.

evidence.text: Synthetic listing; Northbank is fictional. Title: Northbank D18 cordless drill kit. Price: 250.00 SEK. Delivery: 49.00 SEK, with no other mandatory fees. Description: Original empty cardboard box with printed picture of the D18, A18-2 battery and C18-A charger. Selling packaging only. No tool, battery or charger included. The box is in good condition.

hard_failures.text: Recommends this offer as a usable drill or a drill kit, despite the explicit packaging-only description.
Claims the tool, battery or charger is included or its condition has been verified.

usefulness.text: Explains that the actual item is an empty box and therefore does not meet the buyer's need.
Suggests skipping this listing and looking for an actual drill with the necessary battery and charger; does not require a seller question to resolve the already-explicit contents.

acceptable_outcomes: Reject this listing for the stated task. The 299.00 SEK delivered price is for packaging only; mentioning that total is optional.
Suggest another listing assessment without inventing an available alternative.
